$comment: The Host (infected doc §4, act4 doc §3–4, the user's infected spec step 6; ADR-159): the large class, one per source-adjacent place (HIVR, Hebbal, Malleswaram). Slow, can't be stunned or shoved, its body blocks a lane, and the Pulse Gun needs three charges (the first two only stop it for a second). Health 0–100, one heart = 20.
